(1) The curated realism window is right and the template was wrong: Montgomery's c-chart magnitudes are c-bar = 19.85, c = 7.6, c = 2.0, so widening c-bar to 60 to suppress a leak metric was choosing realism to suit the author. c6 imports the constants and lives in [10, 25], at a measured cost — the best cheap-ratio attack rises from 0.716 to 0.909 and distinct answers fall from 328 to 78. Realism outranks the leak metric; both numbers are disclosed. The divisibility tell is removed structurally by sampling the revised centre line first and deriving the total. The anti-leak CLAIM is withdrawn rather than defended: R1's power stub shows the boundary is a smooth curve and therefore always recoverable by fitting, so no threshold branch on continuous inputs can ever satisfy the claim as I had written it. arbiter.rationale: Gate failed on R1's two blocking findings, both introduced by my own c6 remediation. (1) Joint infeasibility is the most serious defect found in this branch: a fix for an entailment problem created a data-existence problem, and it reached a shipped instance. c7 enforces the exact realizability condition as closed bounds on c_min. (2) The missing order-statistic screen on c_2nd is the c2 defect class reintroduced on a new datum; c7 screens both statistics two-sided, and — taking R2's undisclosed-leak finding — evaluates both against the SAME lambda in both regimes, which is both the correct conditioning and regime-symmetric. (3) R1's and R3's majors are one defect with two symptoms: the support had collapsed to 78 backbones because the revised centre line was forced to divide exactly. c7 stops forcing it and pins its rounding in the stem instead — the technique already reviewed and accepted for the two roots — freeing T and c_max. Measured after: 246 distinct answers (from 78), modal 2.14% (from 5.92%), top-10 14.1% (from 38.2%), (T,m) cells admitting more than one c_max 66.1% (from 21.8%), cheap-ratio attack 0.845 (from 0.909), and joint infeasibility 0 (from 4.16%). R2's dead-screen, dead-code and register findings and R3's parallelism findings are also folded in. R3's blind Intermediate is the second consecutive independent confirmation that the de-scaffolding worked.
